page.layout: One printed page, one column of text. Running head at the top left, page number at the top right. Verse from the previous page continues at the top. A rule, then the heading THAV. and the title Carmen ἐπίμικτον. Then the verse poem. Catchword at the right below the last line.

l.i: Negligit, duris sociamque rebus Tendere dextram. Audiunt hostes mea damna sæui Et graues rident gemitus querentis Quòd tuam diro Pater vsque gentem Verbere tundis. Arbiter tandem venias, & illos Clade concussos grauiore perdas, Jam dies nostri redeat seuera Sanguinis ultrix.

INSANIENTUM nequitiam vide Supreme Judex hostium, Et gentes meritis cadibus impias Coniunde, atque pares meis Immitte pœnas, quum flagellis Me nocuam rigidis fatigas, Tuaque gentis cuncta punis crimina. Sic hostes similem meo dolorem Sentiant pressi gemitusque acerbo Pectore voluant.
